_comment: DRISHTI Job Scheduling / Cron descriptors (Phase 14 Part B + H scoping). Catalyst crons are created via the Job Scheduling SDK or the Console (there is no standalone CLI-deployed cron config file), so this is the single reviewed source of the intended schedules, consumed by a setup step at enable time. H MINIMAL SET: enable exactly ONE scheduled aggregate forecast job for the hackathon - 'drishti-forecast-daily'. Every other cron is tier=optional or RESERVED (documented but enabled=false), so multiple schedules + backfill pipelines are deferred. EVERY cron is enabled=false so it never fires and incurs no charge until its owning phase turns it on. Cron expression format is Quartz-like: 'sec min hour day-of-month month day-of-week'. Times are the project timezone (Asia/Kolkata).

minimal_set.note: One scheduled aggregate forecast job is the only cron kept for the hackathon; see signals-rules.json for the one minimal prediction.requested Signal.

crons.name: drishti-forecast-daily
crons.description: The ONE scheduled aggregate forecast job (H): daily aggregate/spatiotemporal forecast dispatch to the protected AWS adapter for the enabled models (TabFM workload / TimesFM). Persists the PredictionRequest authoritative record BEFORE the run; retry + failed-job state per signals-rules retry_policy.

crons.name: drishti-reconcile-nightly
crons.description: Nightly Data Store/Stratus reconciliation, failed-job replay, stale temp cleanup, temporary AWS GPU/Batch shutdown checks, budget/health evidence.
crons.note: OPTIONAL (H) - a second cron is deferred. The J cost-safety cleanup (stop GPU after testing) is otherwise handled by the documented cleanup runbook / AWS scripts, not a required cron.

crons.name: drishti-embeddings-refresh-weekly
crons.description: Approved-source embeddings + similarity index shadow-build/eval/atomic-switch (routed through AppSail/AWS Batch). Reuses the ops cron entrypoint until a dedicated function is enabled.
crons.note: OPTIONAL (H) - multiple embedding index versions are deferred (G.2); single active index only.

crons.name: drishti-board-export (RESERVED)
crons.description: Investigation Board locked-snapshot/export housekeeping. RESERVED - the owning function is created and enabled by Prompt 16.

crons.name: drishti-hazard-feed (RESERVED)
crons.description: Hazard feed ingestion + freshness heartbeat. RESERVED - created and enabled by Prompt 17.

crons.name: drishti-hazard-forecast (RESERVED)
crons.description: Hazard forecast review + alert. RESERVED - created and enabled by Prompt 17. Never auto-warns or issues an all-clear.

crons.name: drishti-resource-allocation (RESERVED)
crons.description: Resource allocation + routing planning. RESERVED - created and enabled by Prompt 17. Never auto-dispatches.
